description:
***See attached amendment 0001 to the solicitation.***

NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price Supply-type Purchase Order for OEM MACGREGOR USA INC Anchor Windlass Replacement Parts on a SOLE SOURCE basis. 

See attached solicitation posted 26 MAR 2026 for requirements. All responses shall be submitted prior to the solicitation closing date on page 1, box 8.
